Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a combination of AP-MS (interactome analysis) and PTM-specific enrichment (phospho-STAT3). While the base workflow is DDA LFQ, the use of phospho-specific antibodies for the pull-down justifies the mod_phospho and mod_ap_ms modifiers.

scope: we performed immunoprecipitation (IP) of pSTAT3 (Y705) followed by LC-MS/MS of whole-cell lysates to identify proteins that interact with pSTAT3
Proteins interacting with pSTAT3 were pulled down together with the pSTAT3 and identified by MS analysis.
For STAT3 and CIP2A pull downs an IgG-bound phospho-specific (Y705) STAT3 antibody and CIP2A specific antibody respectively were used
The pull downs were made using a Pierce™ MS-Compatible Magnetic IP Kit

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics analysis was performed on material affinity-purified via immunoprecipitation of pSTAT3 and CIP2A. While the starting material was whole-cell lysate, the analyzed material was the purified interactome.

Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment specifically focuses on the pSTAT3 interactome comparison between CIP2A-silenced (siRNA) and control (siNT) human Th17 cells. While the paper also discusses mouse KO models and chemical inhibitors (Okadaic acid, FTY720), the MS-based interactome analysis described in the PRIDE metadata and Results section is tied to the siRNA silencing in human cells.
